title: Severe Residential Flooding & Blocked Main Arterial Drain
complaint: My house at 42 Rajendra Nagar is repeatedly flooded during every rain because the main arterial stormwater drain outside is severely blocked with debris. The Municipality ward officer claims the arterial drain falls under PWD jurisdiction and refuses to clear it, while PWD local office has not responded to multiple visits. The backflow is now causing structural dampness and severe property damage to my boundary wall.
expected_claims: Residential flooding caused by blocked arterial drain
Municipality claims drain belongs to PWD
Property boundary wall experiencing structural damage
expected_conflicts: Drain jurisdiction and maintenance responsibility between Municipality and PWD
expected_missing_info: Exact municipal revenue ward cadastral drain asset identifier

title: Discontinued Senior Citizen Disability Pension
complaint: My monthly disability pension has suddenly stopped being credited to my bank account for the past 4 months. The local bank branch manager says the welfare department did not disburse the pension batch, whereas the social security office tells me to check with the bank. I have no other source of livelihood.
expected_claims: Disability pension not credited for 4 consecutive months
Contradictory explanations between bank branch and social security office
expected_conflicts: Disbursement status discrepancy between Welfare Treasury and Disbursement Bank
expected_missing_info: Pension Payment Order (PPO) Number or Beneficiary Aadhaar ID

title: Hazardous High Tension Cable & Road Widening Dispute
complaint: An overhead high-tension electric cable is hanging dangerously low (under 8 feet) across our colony road following storm winds. The Electricity Board states that road widening by the Municipal Corporation raised the road level without statutory clearances, whereas the Municipality asserts the power pole alignment was installed illegally without road right-of-way permission. Meanwhile school buses cannot pass and sparks were seen yesterday.
expected_claims: Hazardous low-hanging HT electrical line posing imminent danger
Electricity Board alleges unauthorized road height increase by Municipality
Municipality alleges illegal power pole alignment without right-of-way
expected_conflicts: Statutory clearance and right-of-way compliance between Electricity Board and Municipality
expected_missing_info: Colony pole number and feeder transformer identifier

title: Commercial Demolition Damage and Compensation Demand
complaint: During an anti-encroachment drive conducted by the Town Planning enforcement squad, the heavy JCB equipment accidentally demolished a registered commercial godown shed belonging to my firm, destroying stored goods worth 12 Lakh Rupees. The revenue surveyor admitted on-site that our plot was outside the demarcation line. I demand immediate compensation and suspension of further demolition until formal joint survey.
expected_claims: Accidental demolition of private property outside encroachment zone
Financial loss and inventory destruction worth Rs 12,00,000
Demand for financial compensation and stay on demolition
expected_conflicts: Encroachment demarcation vs registered private title deed boundary
expected_missing_info: Registered property deed and commercial inventory loss audit report

title: Non-Functional Streetlight Near Women's Hostel
complaint: The pole-mounted LED streetlight outside the working women's hostel has been non-functional for 3 weeks, leaving the alley completely dark and unsafe at night.
expected_claims: Streetlight LED fixture broken for 3 weeks
